messages:
Maya K: Heads-up — after enabling adaptive routing for the canary cohort, p95 on /v1/chat jumped ~200ms for that cohort. Not seeing the same in prod routes. :thinking:
Alex P: Uh — can you paste the numbers and the cohort id?
Maya K: cohort=canary-alpha, quick snapshot from console: p50=120ms, p95=420ms, p99=820ms (last 10m). The stable cohort stayed ~p95=220ms.
Samir: Do we know whether those requests hit a different model variant or were falling back? Adaptive routing might route to smaller cheaper variants sometimes.
Maya K: Logs show a mix. I grabbed some samples: ``route=adaptive model=redwood-lite fallback=false latency_ms=118`` and a handful like ``route=adaptive model=redwood-legacy fallback=true latency_ms=412``.
Leo (infra): That fallback=true is suspicious — fallback to legacy likely nukes KV cache locality. If the routing policy flips to a variant without warm KV cache, p95 will spike.
Alex P: Is the dashboard breakdown showing routing_policy or only endpoint+model? The console UI groups by endpoint and model today AFAIK.
Maya K: Right now the breakdown has endpoint/model but not the routing_policy tag — so the canary cohort is mixed and the percentile gets 'snippeted' by ambiguous rollups (we're seeing composite percentiles across mixes).
Samir: I think this is two issues: 1) routing policy metadata isn't preserved in rollups, so percentile attribution mixes cohorts; 2) quota/fallback behaviour causes warm->cold transitions.
Alex P: For short-term, can we add a temporary metric tag when the request is routed (e.g., emit tag routing_policy=adaptive|fallback) so rollups show separate percentiles? That would make it visible in SLO dashboards.
Leo (infra): We can emit routing_policy as a top-level label at ingress. Small overhead. Need to change instrumentation + telemetry pipeline mapping to include it in the rollup keys. I'll open an infra PR.
Maya K: Also suggests adding a sample filter in the console to slice percentiles by routing_policy. Right now you can't isolate the cohort without manual query.
devex-bot: Note: dashboard-sample-filter feature is tracked in GH #3245.
Samir: Medium-term we should change adaptive routing fallback behaviour to prefer variant with warmed cache or pre-warm on failover. Otherwise we'll keep getting noisy p95 blips.
Alex P: Agreed. For the rollout gate, let's add a canary flag to force no-fallback for first 10k requests, and add metric breakouts. If p95 stays high we rollback.
Maya K: I'll update the runbook and add the console slice request (routing_policy) to the ticket.
Leo (infra): PR incoming: telemetry will accept routing_policy label; I'll wire to rollups as a separate aggregation key. ETA EOD.
Alex P: Perfect. Once in, Maya can re-evaluate the p95. If anything else, ping #eng-platform-alerts. :thumbsup:
